infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: EcoResQ requires camera access to inspect surplus food quality and scan QR verification codes during pickup.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: EcoResQ requires location access to match nearby food donors, NGOs, and volunteers for live route tracking.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: EcoResQ needs photo library access to upload food donation pictures for AI freshness analysis.

plugins.cameraPermission: Grant EcoResQ permission to use the camera for food freshness verification and QR scanning.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow EcoResQ to use your location to find nearest food surplus donations and optimize volunteer routes.
